title: Frontier Agent-Skill Rubric
summary: Score a single SKILL.md across five dimensions. Every dimension is graded 0-5 and PASS requires every dimension >= pass_threshold (no averaging).

dimensions.title: FORMAT
dimensions.criteria: YAML frontmatter parses; name EXACTLY equals the directory slug; description <= 1024 chars stating WHAT + WHEN-to-use + WHEN-NOT; version present; scannable markdown; no broken references/ links.

checks.desc: The leading --- fenced block parses as YAML.
Frontmatter name is byte-for-byte equal to the containing directory name.
description key exists and is non-empty after trim.
len(description) <= 1024 (Claude Code truncates longer descriptions at load time).
Description opens with what the skill does (a capability/verb clause).
Description names positive triggers (use-when / trigger phrases).
Description names anti-triggers (not-for / do-not-use / instead-of).
version key exists in frontmatter.
Body uses headings/lists/code fences, not one undifferentiated block.
Every references/ and scripts/ path mentioned in SKILL.md resolves to an existing file.

anchors.5: All hard and soft checks pass; description crisply states WHAT + WHEN + WHEN-NOT; body is cleanly sectioned; every internal link resolves.
anchors.4: All hard checks pass; at most one soft check is weak (e.g. WHEN-NOT is implicit rather than explicit).
anchors.3: A soft failure plus a borderline hard item (e.g. description at 1010/1024 with no anti-triggers), or scannability is poor.
anchors.2: One hard check fails (name != slug, missing version, or one broken references/ link).
anchors.0: Frontmatter does not parse, description missing/over cap, or multiple hard checks fail.

dimensions.title: DEPTH
dimensions.criteria: Technically accurate and expert-level; concrete commands, APIs, and parameters rather than vague prose; deep material pushed to references/.

checks.desc: Claims, commands, and APIs are real and correct — verify against source, do not accept invented calls.
Instructions name exact commands/flags/params/functions, not hand-wavy 'configure appropriately'.
Expert detail lives in references/, keeping SKILL.md a router.

anchors.5: Expert-level and precise throughout; every instruction is actionable with real commands/APIs; references carry the deep material.
anchors.4: Solid and accurate; concrete in the parts that matter, with at most minor vagueness that does not block a practitioner.
anchors.3: Mixed — some concrete guidance but notable vague passages, or one shallow section a practitioner would have to fill in.
anchors.2: Mostly generic prose; few real commands/APIs; or a factual/API error that would mislead.
anchors.0: Vague throughout or materially inaccurate (invented APIs, wrong commands).

dimensions.title: COMPLETENESS
dimensions.criteria: Covers the full scope of the skill's stated job; addresses edge cases, failure modes, and boundaries; leaves no gap a practitioner hits in real use.

checks.desc: Everything the description promises is actually addressed somewhere in the skill.
Edge cases, failure modes, and error paths are called out, not just the happy path.
The skill states what it does NOT do and where to go instead.

anchors.5: Full stated scope covered; edge cases, failure modes, and boundaries explicit; a practitioner hits no surprising gap.
anchors.4: Full scope and the main failure modes covered; a minor edge case is thin but not blocking.
anchors.3: Happy path solid but a real failure mode or part of the promised scope is missing.
anchors.2: Multiple gaps — a practitioner would get stuck following it in a common case.
anchors.0: Only a sketch; large parts of the stated scope are absent.

dimensions.title: STRUCTURED DISCLOSURE
dimensions.criteria: SKILL.md is a concise router (target < ~12 KB) that delegates depth to references/; it is not a wall of text.

checks.desc: SKILL.md byte size is at or under the ~12 KB router budget.
SKILL.md points to references/ for depth instead of inlining it.
Reads as a scannable router, not an essay.

anchors.5: SKILL.md is well under budget, cleanly routes to references/, and every deep topic has a home outside the router.
anchors.4: At or near budget; routes to references/ for the heavy material with at most one section slightly too long.
anchors.3: Over budget or inlines depth that belongs in references/, but still navigable.
anchors.2: Wall of text; references/ underused; the router does the work the references should do.
anchors.0: Everything crammed into SKILL.md; no meaningful progressive disclosure.

dimensions.title: FRONTIER-MODEL GUIDELINES
dimensions.criteria: Imperative voice; clear triggers and anti-triggers; explicit boundaries; cross-links to sibling skills; no redundancy; nothing misleading.

checks.desc: Directs the model in the imperative ('Run', 'Read', 'Score'), not passive narration.
Triggers and anti-triggers are unambiguous so the router fires correctly.
Names sibling skills and when to prefer them.
No material repetition across SKILL.md and references.
No claim that would cause the model to do the wrong thing or overstate capability.

anchors.5: Imperative and tight; triggers/anti-triggers crisp; cross-links present; zero redundancy; nothing misleading.
anchors.4: Mostly imperative with clear triggers and boundaries; a little redundancy or one missing cross-link.
anchors.3: Guidance is usable but drifts into narration, or triggers/anti-triggers blur at the edges.
anchors.2: Weak triggers or noticeable redundancy that would degrade routing or waste context.
anchors.0: Misleading guidance, or triggers so vague the router cannot place the skill.

scorecard_contract.desc: Shape emitted by scripts/eval_skill.py and consumed by scripts/gate.py.

fields.rubric_version: string — copied from this file; every scorecard is stamped with the rubric it was graded under
fields.target: string — path to the scored skill directory
fields.auto_checks: object — raw deterministic results (booleans, description length, skill byte size)
fields.dimensions: object keyed by dimension id -> {score:int|null, auto:bool, notes:[string]}
fields.min_score: int|null — lowest dimension score once all are filled
fields.pass: bool|null — null until every dimension is scored; else min_score >= pass_threshold
